description: TXN-FLUSH-OP, dbImplicitCommitSync = "Yes" without a kill (the first card's evidence was one kill per format). After DBEngine.SetOption(59, "Yes") the implicit INSERT...SELECT runs on the big fixture and the main file's size and hash are read right after the return and every 50 ms for 500 ms; then SetOption(59, "No") and the same statement with the same timeline. Asks whether the file image has changed when Execute returns under Yes and when it changes under No.
